specimen-empty: This specimen carries no animal. It cannot be mounted.
mount-help: Empty hand: sneak + right-click to adjust it (pose, position, rotation), right-click to pick it up. A wrench turns it.
mount-item-help: Right-click a block to place it. Empty hand: sneak + right-click to adjust, right-click to pick up.
head-raw-help: Seal it in a barrel with 1 litre of diluted borax for 18 hours (zinc sulfate, 12) to preserve it.
head-preserved-help: Stuff it in the crafting grid with a raw hide ({0} suits this animal) and dry grass to make a mount, or hang it on an antler mount - sneak + right-click the mount to adjust it.
mount-help-rotate: Wrench, Rotate mode: right-click turns it, sprint + right-click turns it back. Switch tool mode for poses.
mount-help-pose: Wrench, Pose mode: right-click is the next pose, sprint + right-click the previous one.
mount-help-adjust: Wrench, Adjust mode: right-click opens the adjust window (pose, position, rotation).
